prior_importants.description: "`pup plan` lists its goal, scope-in and acceptance criteria" is wrong: `pup plan` only prints each task's id, tier, goal headline and scope-in globs. No `pup plan` verb shows the acceptance criteria.
"Open the PR with `/pr-description`, writing `Closes #<n>`" contradicts `/pr-description`, which still says this repo has no tracker and the PR must carry no `Closes` line.

process_issues.description: The checkout HEAD was 98bdbd4c, but the PR head is e37ec961 (fix commit a6c4fb2 plus a merge of main), and a6c4fb2 was not in the local object store. Reviewers and prior-important checks used `gh pr diff 435` as the authoritative text. The `.claude-pr/` copy of implement/SKILL.md was the stale 98bdbd4c version.

The conventions reviewer did not open ADR 0176 or search for in-repo skill-writing guidance. It checked the diff only against the spike's T7 entry and AGENTS.md. The PR is a 4-line docs-only change, so the risk is low, but conventions coverage was shallow.

Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety, maintainability and spec. The diff is 4 changed prose lines in one skill file, with no code, no trust boundary, no workflow and no closing issue.
